\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage[paperwidth=420pt,paperheight=560pt,textwidth=310pt,textheight=210pt,top=42pt]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}\raggedbottom
\AddToHook{para/before}{\vskip0pt minus 4pt\relax}

\makeatletter
\newwrite\FTentries\immediate\openout\FTentries=\jobname.entries
\newwrite\FTpieces\immediate\openout\FTpieces=\jobname.pieces
\newwrite\FTtails\immediate\openout\FTtails=\jobname.tails
\newcount\FTformatted
\let\FTformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\FTformatted by1
  \protected@write\FTentries{}{ENTRY \the\dte@tnum:#1}%
  \edef\@currentlabel{ENTRY #1}\label{FT:\the\dte@tnum:#1}%
  \FTformat{#1}}
\let\FTpiece\dte@drawpiece
\def\dte@drawpiece#1{%
  \protected@write\FTpieces{}{PIECE #1;ht=\the\ht\dte@splitresult;dp=\the\dp\dte@splitresult}%
  \FTpiece{#1}}
\newcount\FTskips\let\FTskip\dte@skipcolumn
\def\dte@skipcolumn{\global\advance\FTskips by1
  \ifnum\FTskips>100\errmessage{FT no progress}\fi\FTskip}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{FT-FORMATTED \the\FTformatted}}
\makeatother
\makeatletter\let\FTrender\dte@render@tree\def\dte@render@tree{\FTrender\penalty-10000 \write\FTtails{TAIL-EFFECT}}\makeatother

\makeatletter
\newcount\ZThits
\newif\ifZTzero
\def\ZTerror#1{\PackageError{lifecycle-zero-tail}{#1}{A nonvoid zero-extent tail must be retained in selected output.}}
\def\ZTstate{\ifhmode H\else V\fi:\ifinner I\else O\fi:\number\currentgrouplevel:\the\dte@piecenum:\the\dte@defercount:\the\dte@pagecount:\number\wd\dte@framebox:\number\ht\dte@framebox:\number\dp\dte@framebox}
\let\ZTclassify\dte@classify@split
\def\dte@classify@split#1{%
  \ZTzerofalse
  \ifvoid#1\else
    \ifdim\dimexpr\ht#1+\dp#1\relax=0pt\relax\ZTzerotrue\fi
  \fi
  \edef\ZTbefore{\ZTstate}%
  \edef\ZThooks{\the\everyvbox}%
  \ZTclassify#1%
  \edef\ZTafter{\ZTstate}%
  \ifx\ZTbefore\ZTafter\else\ZTerror{Classification changed output state or original rows}\fi
  \edef\ZTafter{\the\everyvbox}%
  \ifx\ZThooks\ZTafter\else\ZTerror{Box hook tokens not restored}\fi
  \ifZTzero
    \ifvoid#1\else\ZTerror{Zero tail was not consumed}\fi
    \ifvoid\dte@splitresult\ZTerror{Selected rows lost during tail attachment}\fi
    \ifx\dte@piecetype\dte@plast\else\ZTerror{Zero tail did not classify as last}\fi
    \global\advance\ZThits by1
    \typeout{ZT-ATTACHED ordinal=\the\dte@piecenum;source-height=\the\ht\dte@framebox}%
  \fi}
\AtEndDocument{%
  \ifnum\ZThits>0\else\ZTerror{No nonvoid zero-extent remainder was tested}\fi
  \ifnum\FTformatted=17\else\ZTerror{Rows were lost or formatted repeatedly}\fi
  \typeout{ZT-ALL-CHECKS-PASSED attachments=\the\ZThits;rows=\the\FTformatted}}
\makeatother
